rows.label: Evacuee
rows.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.

rows.label: Challenge - Really Bad Day
rows.description: You start drunk to the point of incapacitation, depressed, infected, and surrounded by fire.  This day went downhill really fast.

rows.label: Challenge - Lab Patient
rows.description: The scientists stopped their experiments on you abruptly, leaving you behind while they evacuated before lockdown.  Find a way to escape or starve to death.

rows.label: Challenge - Lab Staff
rows.description: You were deemed non-essential and made to stay behind during the lab evacuation.  Find a way to escape or starve to death.

rows.label: Challenge - Abandoned
rows.description: Sickly and frail, you have spent years in the patient's ward of the hospital.  When yours was evacuated, you were left behind because you were a lost cause.  You awaken to the sound of movement around the hospital.

rows.label: Challenge - Mi-Go Camp
rows.description: You find yourself in the most alien place you've ever seen.  The hot humid air and the organic aspect of the structure makes you feel like you're trapped inside a giant creature.  Whatever it is, you need to get out of here before They find you.

rows.label: Challenge - Island Prison
rows.description: You were at a high-security prison right before the Cataclysm.  You managed to make it outside the inner walls…  Too bad it's located on a remote island, and now you need to find out how to escape it too.

rows.label: Challenge - Trans-Coast Logistics Concourse
rows.description: You were deemed an essential employee and required to stay behind during the facility's evacuation.  You'd better find a keycard before something finds you.

rows.label: Challenge - The Lost And Damned
rows.description: You spent the first few weeks of the Cataclysm in a dull haze.  The riots have died down and the summer sun has drawn out the stench of decay.  You stagger out of your hiding place with a gnawing hunger, unsure if you're the only one left alive, or if this is what living death is like.

rows.label: Helicopter Crash
rows.description: While being transported to a different military base, the pilot lost control of the helicopter and crashed in the middle of nowhere.  Hopefully some of the soldiers that were with you also survived the accident.

rows.label: Challenge - Emergency Shutdown
rows.description: When the Cataclysm happened, you were working in a nuclear power plant.  Now you're trapped inside, surrounded by the shambling bodies of what used to be your coworkers.  The reactor's shut down, but you don't know if there's been a radiation leak and you need to get away from here fast before you find out the hard way.

rows.label: Infected
rows.description: In the chaos and panic of evacuation, you got bitten by something!  You didn't get proper medical care, and now the wound has started turning green.

rows.label: Prison
rows.description: When the Cataclysm happened, you were convicted or working in a prison.  Now the prisoners have turned into mindless horrors and the security bots are shooting on sight… you might need to expedite your escape plans.

rows.label: Ambush
rows.description: It is the winter after zero hour.  As you were scavenging for food and a warm place to stay at, you heard the sound of lots of movement nearby.

rows.label: Sheltered
rows.description: When the apocalypse broke out, you were funneled into the nearest shelter.  Here you have lived, never leaving, lest the unknowns of the outside world hurt you.  Supplies are running low, and for the first time since the Cataclysm, you will be forced to face the outside world.

rows.label: Surrounded
rows.description: You've attracted the attention of living dead in some way, now they're all around and you'll likely have to fight thorough them if you want to escape.

rows.label: Challenge - Hunted
rows.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it, but it always seems to find you eventually.  The only escape is for one of you to die.

rows.label: Burning Building
rows.description: The building you had chosen to reside in has suddenly caught fire!  You might want to leave.

rows.label: Challenge - Bordered
rows.description: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  The only thing that really bothers you is a mysterious sky-high wall seen in the distance.

rows.label: The Metro
rows.description: In the chaos of the Cataclysm, you decided to make a run for the subway tunnels, hoping to find refuge away from the horrors on the surface.  Now, you find yourself in the dark tunnels of the subway system, and yet you feel like you're not alone...

rows.label: Missed
rows.description: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation, and are stuck in a city full of the risen dead.

rows.label: Challenge - Temporal Anomaly
rows.description: A temporal distortion has hurled you into this collapsing world. You arrive carrying only the few items that mattered most to you - the things tied to who you are, or who you were meant to become.

rows.label: The Next Summer
rows.description: A little over a year has passed since the apocalypse started, and you're about to face your second summer in Hell.

rows.label: The Mascot Rises
rows.description: You just finished your shift and got back in the break room when you heard the alarms and the security door shutting down behind you.  There's a lot of customers out there and you're not sure Foodplace's delicious food™ is going to be enough for them.

rows.label: Wilderness
rows.description: You find yourself amongst trees.  The screaming and the moaning is fainter this far from civilization, but you'd better know what you're doing out here.

rows.label: One Last Assassination
rows.description: Your mission required you to eliminate a certain high-ranking individual in hiding. Your mark seems to have turned feral while escaping and the world appears to be ending, but not even that can stop you from finishing your mission.

rows.label: Crazy Party
rows.description: You thought things couldn't get any worse when the cops came over to bust your wild party, even though you booked it at a private resort.  When the guests started fighting with the police you tried to get them to calm down, only to find out they hungered for more.

rows.label: Armored Apocalypse
rows.description: Wandering in search of any other survivors after a disastrous mobilization, your tank and its crew have slowly been worn down by attrition.  After trying to establish communications using an old radio tower, the only other surviving crew member went off in search of supplies and fuel a few days ago.  Now something's stirred up the undead, several are converging on your position.

rows.label: Death And Taxes
rows.description: Conducting an audit of a corporate office's records as part of a career-making official investigation, you found your hosts suddenly much less cooperative. It may be time to render summary judgment and haul ass out of this tower of toil.

rows.label: Pond Scum
rows.description: Before the cataclysm, you spent your days exploring the local area's lakes and waterways.

rows.label: Safe Place
rows.description: You've found some distant safe place, devoid of the living dead.  Looks like you're on your own...

rows.label: Survivor Holdout
rows.description: A few days after fleeing the chaos of the cities, you've finally found a place still inhabited by the living.

rows.label: Bottom of a Mine
rows.description: You were participating in a mining operation when you found… something.  You're not sure what, but it sure is dark down here.

rows.label: Basement Dweller
rows.description: You were happiest tucked away below street level, tinkering and hiding in your basement.

rows.label: Experiment
rows.description: Since birth, your sole purpose in life has been the advancement of genetic science, willingly or not.  Once the Cataclysm struck, you left the lab, and wandered aimlessly, ending up in a forest.

rows.label: The Last Delivery
rows.description: While the world was falling apart someone called to order some of Foodplace's delicious food™ and they sent you to do the delivery.  You're not sure about much, but one thing is certain: that delicious food™ is going to get delivered even if that's the last thing you do!

rows.label: Last Flight
rows.description: Once it became clear that the world was ending you took to the skies, hoping that your flying skills could lead you to safety.  With no safe landing zones, knowing fuel will soon be a concern, you made a quick landing to plan your next move.

rows.label: High Tech, Low Life
rows.description: Before the world ended, bionics were reserved for the rich and the famous.  You might not have been either, but you wanted in.  Hidden offices sequestered away in basements, anesthetic smuggled out of hospitals, and desperate people with little to lose could get you what you wanted.  If you went too deep, however, your augmentation may have come at a price...

rows.label: Overrun
rows.description: Despite all the soldiers, guns and minefields, the base you were on got overrun by the dead.  Everyone was ordered to fall back to the armory, but during all the chaos you got lost and didn't make it there in time.  You are not sure if anyone made it to the armory, or if you are the last man alive.

rows.label: CVN Sailor
rows.description: For some reason your mission off the coast of North Korea has ended up stateside, stuck in the middle of a lake.  You have no idea what's happened, but now you have more important things to do.

valid.name: character creation on the profession page

rows.label: Survivor
rows.description: Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you.  But you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.

rows.label: Churl
rows.description: What the deuyl?  Ye ne wist noo thing of this straunge plaas nor what wycked enchauntment brought ye hidder.  Wyth this accoustrement ye must needs underfongen to find newe lyflode in the most hidous Cataclysm man hath witnessed sithen that deluge Noe rood out in his greet schippe.

rows.label: Prehistoric Hunter
rows.description: An out-of-place living relic of prehistory, stranded in an unfamiliar and terrifying world.  Life as a hunter-gatherer was hard, but at least you didn't have to fight the living dead, and you had your kin to stand beside you.  Here, you're on your own.

rows.label: Defective Cyborg
rows.description: You were normal once.  Before the tests, before the procedures, before they stripped away every outward sign of your humanity.  You're more machine than man now, but that might prove an advantage against the horrors that await.

rows.label: Crackhead
rows.description: Cocaine.  It is, indeed, a helluva drug.  You blew your money on some dust, and before you knew it you were turning tricks behind the local CVS just to score one more line.

rows.label: Tweaker
rows.description: You're not entirely sure what happened, but everything has gone to shit, and the only thing running through your head is where you're gonna find your next hit.

rows.label: Failed Cyborg
rows.description: Your body is a wreck of bionic parts.  You have a large capacity for power, but are filled with broken bionics.  At least your ethanol power supply still works.

rows.label: Chain Smoker
rows.description: Everyone at work knew you as the person who always had a cigarette or two in hand.  Now, you're down to a single pack, and you hope you find more soon.  You start out with a strong nicotine addiction.

rows.label: Hobo
rows.description: Society drove you to the fringes and set you wandering, with no home, no family, no friends, until you could only find solace in the bottom of a bottle.  But society doesn't mean a thing anymore, and for all the crap thrown your way, you're still standing.  God damn, you need a drink.

rows.label: Pillhead
rows.description: After an accident in your youth, you got addicted to the opiates treating your pain.  With the pharmacies shut down and dealers turned undead, satisfying your fix just got a lot more difficult.

rows.label: Shower Victim
rows.description: You were in the middle of a nice, hot shower when the Cataclysm struck!  You barely managed to escape with some soap and the most massively useful thing ever…  a towel.

rows.label: Hitchhiker
rows.description: Your house has been demolished and your planet destroyed, but at least you still have your towel.

rows.label: Clown
rows.description: All you ever wanted was to make people laugh.  Dropping out of school and performing at kids' parties was a dream come true until the world ended.  There's precious few balloon animals in your future now.

rows.label: Lost Submissive
rows.description: Early in the rush to safety, you were separated from your master by cruel fate.  Now you are on your own with nothing to your name but a suit of really kinky black leather.  Unfortunately, there's no safewords in the apocalypse.

rows.label: Groom
rows.description: The Cataclysm struck on the big day and you escaped with nothing but your wedding attire.  Cold feet?  You'd just like to keep your feet attached!

rows.label: Novice Martial Artist
rows.description: You were on your way to the dojo for your first lesson when the world ended.  And you really wanted to learn how to swim, too.

rows.label: Naked and Afraid
rows.description: You were out filming a reality TV show in the woods and the cast and crew all seemed to have turned into zombies.  Looks like it's for real now…

rows.label: True Foodperson
rows.description: You are the true Foodperson, some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  You are Foodperson, the mask has become your face, you are real and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.

rows.label: Used Car Salesman
rows.description: You've been accused of being the sort of person who'd be willing to sell your own mother for a dollar.  It always left you insulted - you've been around the block a time or two, and you'd charge way more than a dollar - and get it, too!

rows.label: Backpacker
rows.description: You've traveled for a living, sightseeing here and there, and living off your parents' trust fund.  But now they're gone, and the only thing between you and death is the open road and your backpack.

rows.label: Fast Food Cook
rows.description: You used to work at a fancy fast food joint a week ago, but now you show the meaning of "fast" food by running for your life.

rows.label: Student
rows.description: You were a high school student, but the tests you'll face now will have much higher stakes.  There might even be something useful in one of these books you've been lugging around all year.

rows.label: Senior Citizen
rows.description: You haven't seen this much blood since the war.  The whole world's gone crazy!  They ate your grandkids!  But dagnabbit, you'll make them all pay for what they've done.

rows.label: Punk Rock Dude
rows.description: The apocalypse has been your psychotic dream come true.  Now that the system is dead, it's time to party among the bones of the world!

rows.label: Rude Boy
rows.description: Your ska band broke up after the drummer became a zombie, now you're alone in the Cataclysm with some cigarettes and your mp3 player.

rows.label: Rioter
rows.description: The first protest you were at started peaceful, until they hosed the crowd down with machinegun fire instead of water cannons.  You escaped, and came prepared for a fight next time.  You weren't prepared for the cops and protesters to tear themselves apart in a cannibalistic frenzy.

rows.label: Convict
rows.description: The Cataclysm gave you a chance to escape, but freedom comes with a steep price.

rows.label: Cyberjunkie
rows.description: Long ago your lifelong infatuation with bionic enhancement lead you into a shady world of back-alley bionic clinics and self-installed secondhand CBMs.  The world has moved on but your posthuman hunger still cries out to be fed; where will you get your bionic fix now?

rows.label: Priest
rows.description: When the apocalypse struck, you did everything you could to protect your parish faithful, but it appears that prayers were not enough.  Now that they are all dead, you should probably find something more tangible to protect you.

rows.label: Kannushi
rows.description: You were one of the maintainers of a Shinto shrine, performing rituals and sacred tasks.  You preferred it when only the spirits of the dead inhabited your shrine, and not their rotting corpses.

rows.label: Imam
rows.description: You spent much of your time prior to the apocalypse at the local mosque, studying the words of the Prophet and the Quran, and guiding your community in prayer.  Back then they came from far and wide to listen to you, now they come to eat your brains.

rows.label: Rabbi
rows.description: You were celebrating with your flock in the temple when the Cataclysm struck.  You sure could use a messiah right now!

rows.label: Pizza Delivery Boy
rows.description: You were delivering the last pizza of the night to the local cryogenics lab when the Cataclysm hit.  Fleeing to the nearest shelter, you find yourself with only your wits and some leftover pizza.  And they didn't even leave a tip!

rows.label: Mall Security
rows.description: A mall security guard.  You don't have any useful skills, other than some basic training for your job.  You do however have your trusty tazer, baton, and pocket knife.

rows.label: Teacher
rows.description: You've been teaching kids for the whole of your life, and they've mostly listened to your teachings.  However, the dead won't write out lines for eating you alive.

rows.label: Photojournalist
rows.description: You were a freelance photojournalist before the end.  You have a chance to be the first journalist to cover the apocalypse, though finding a publisher seems more difficult a prospect than usual.  You managed to hold onto your camera, hopefully you can get some fantastic shots.

rows.label: Tourist
rows.description: You came here to get a taste of New England; Now you hope New England won't get a taste of you!

rows.label: Golfer
rows.description: You decided to get away from the family for the day to do a little golfing by yourself.  You were almost done playing the back nine when you called to check on them and realized you couldn't get a signal.

rows.label: Urban Samurai
rows.description: You were always an inexplicable sight in town, always with the funny hair, always wearing what appeared to be some kind of Japanese bathrobe.  Some claimed you were a visiting Shinto god.  Little of this concerns you, but last week the grocery service stopped coming and now the TV no longer turns on.  This displeases you.

rows.label: Musician
rows.description: You were just about to hit the stage when the Cataclysm struck.  You weren't able to grab much during the panic, but at least you have your loaded six string on your back.

rows.label: Kitted Survivor
rows.description: At the local mall, you saw a sign advertising a discount on survival kits.  You bought one, more for show than for actual use.  Now, it's all you have.

rows.label: Vagabond
rows.description: Circumstances left you wandering, with no home, no family, no friends.  But the world you knew is gone, and maybe your experiences relying on yourself to survive could be useful in this new one.

rows.label: Lonesome Drifter
rows.description: You thought you were just another resident of Massachusetts, until the undead came calling. Armed with blinkies, a shotgun, and a set of survival rules, you know the best way to survive is to keep moving, shoot straight, and never forget your seatbelt.  You've heard the Cataclysm hasn't reached the west, so that's where you're heading.

rows.label: Chef
rows.description: Bork bork!  Years in the kitchen have left you carrying a prodigious bulk, but you managed to escape the carnage with a butchers knife and only a small collection of stains on your uniform.

rows.label: Butler
rows.description: You worked in a wealthy household, but after the Cataclysm they took a family vacation to an unknown place, leaving you to fend for yourself.

rows.label: Security Guard
rows.description: A low paid security guard, things have suddenly gotten a lot more dangerous than patrolling the grounds warding off potential thieves.  You don't have many particularly useful skills, but you do have some useful equipment since you were on the job when things started going south.

rows.label: Landscaper
rows.description: You used to mow lawns and trim hedges for the wealthy.  Contract work was getting scarce even before the zombies came, but now you've got nothing left but your tools and expertise.

rows.label: Nursing Assistant
rows.description: You were providing in-home care for the elderly, even as the whole world fell apart around you.  You can only pray that you don't see your former clients among the walking dead…

rows.label: Dumpster Diver
rows.description: Before the Cataclysm, you lived off what others threw away. Now that the world has leveled the playing field, your eye for salvage makes you a survivor, not a beggar.

rows.label: Crypto Millionaire
rows.description: Before the Cataclysm, you were a shut-in NEET who struck gold on an obscure cryptocoin. Money couldn’t buy you friends or fitness, but it filled your apartment with gadgets, snacks, and time to waste. When the world ended, your fortune meant nothing—except the gear you had the sense (or luck) to keep close.

rows.label: Fashion Model
rows.description: Once worshiped for looks, not survival skills. Now that the world has leveled the playing field, glamour won’t save you.

rows.label: Handy Man
rows.description: You used to work at a local hardware store, and you did a lot of home renovations yourself.  Now you look out at the horizon of a ruined world, and wonder - are your meager skills, and the few supplies you grabbed on the way out, sufficient to help it rebuild?

rows.label: Lumberjack
rows.description: You're a lumberjack, and you're okay.  You felled trees before the world ended, but suspect the undead aren't nearly as tough.

rows.label: Electrician
rows.description: You used to work for some small-time business owners doing minor electrical work, and were on your way to another trivial job when the Cataclysm struck.  The power's out, but if you survive long enough you might be able to improvise.

rows.label: Computer Hacker
rows.description: Caffeine pills and all-nighters in front of a computer screen have given you skills in an area that seem, on the face of it, distinctly less-than-useful when the world has ended.  Unless you manage to find a military mainframe.

rows.label: Library Nerd
rows.description: They say reading is food for the brain, but those corpses seem to see your brain as food.  In your haste to escape, you grabbed the library's return box, but is there anything in there that might help you?

rows.label: Ballroom Dancer
rows.description: You used to be a ballroom dancer before the Cataclysm, and now you use your skills to save your life.

rows.label: Blacksmith
rows.description: You were going through your community college's metalsmithing program when the world ended.  You ran into trouble coming out of class - but managed to keep ahold of the equipment you were carrying at the time.

rows.label: Otaku
rows.description: Late nights with friends watching anime and eating snacks has prepared you for the premier anime convention in the Northeast.  It just had to be the day of the apocalypse.  At least you were ready in case your costume tore.

rows.label: Fursuiter
rows.description: You had plans to attend a local convention after your custom order finally arrived, only to find the world is ending.  You're starting to wish the company you bought this from made something armored and scaly instead.

rows.label: Mail Carrier
rows.description: Your skill at avoiding dogs and discarded children's toys while delivering the mail gives you an edge in your new role as a survivor.

rows.label: Death Row Convict
rows.description: You were a serial killer ready to walk the green mile, but now everyone else is dead, and since true death comes only from your hands, you're in for a job.

rows.label: Lawyer
rows.description: Now instead of complaining about your fees, your clients try to eat your brain.  You can't tell which one is worse though.

rows.label: Guru
rows.description: You spent many years traveling through the world, becoming wise and learned.  Normally, you can answer any question, but even you are not quite sure what to do about the ravenous undead.

rows.label: Preacher
rows.description: You devoted your life to spreading the good word, always on the road, traveling from town to town.  Now, everything has gone to hell, you can't host your daily podcast and the undead listening to your sermons don't seem particularly moved.

rows.label: Delivery Drone Pilot
rows.description: When the riots started it was still business as usual at work, since they had you handling online orders and contactless delivery, but the undead are much more insistent about in-store pickup than the living.  You fled with what was going to be your last delivery order and the drone that was going to ship it.

rows.label: Farmer
rows.description: You were making a living by raising crops, when the Cataclysm struck.  Now, with your trusty hoe and some seeds it's time to rebuild the Earth, one plant at a time.

rows.label: Rollerblader
rows.description: You love to skate!  At least now the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.

rows.label: Skateboarder
rows.description: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a skateboard than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.

rows.label: Juvenile Delinquent
rows.description: You never cared for grown-ups telling you what to do, and that's how you ended up spending most of your days in the principal's office.  Now, not needing grown-ups to tell you what to do is the only reason you're alive.  Man, you really should've played hooky today.

rows.label: Survivalist Jr.
rows.description: Your parents were crazy preppers who thought some "Cataclysm" was coming, and insisted on preparing you for it.  Turns out they were right.  You didn't get a chance to thank them.  The only thing you can do for them now is what they always hoped you would do in the dark days ahead: survive to see bright nights again.

rows.label: Dodgeball Player
rows.description: You liked to play dodgeball, where failing to dodge the ball meant you were out.  Now failing to dodge threatens your life.  Don't slip up.

rows.label: Science Club Member
rows.description: You were a member of the school science club, and right now you're as upset as you've ever been that the school wouldn't let you play with the really fun chemicals that make things go boom.  At least now no one's around to tell you that you can't.

rows.label: A/V Club Member
rows.description: You were a member of the school A/V club.  You're sure there's some way you can use your technical skills to help stay alive.  You just haven't figured out how to make an awesome death ray yet.

rows.label: Miner
rows.description: You're a miner, not a minor!  Your jackhammer may be gassed up, but your canteen is dry, and you're on your last pair of batteries for your mining helmet…

rows.label: Game Master
rows.description: Trying to herd cats into getting into one place every week has taught you something: it's usually better to cut your losses and trust your gut.  For that reason, when you had two no-shows and the other two tried to eat you, you ditched.  Maybe you can find some new players in the ruins of the world.

rows.label: Zoo Keeper
rows.description: You were called in on your day off to feed the animals at the zoo because none of your coworkers showed up for work for one reason or another.

rows.label: Roadie
rows.description: You worked just outside of the limelight, ensuring that the performers got what they needed and that everything ran smoothly.  The stakes are higher these days, but the show must go on.

rows.label: Urban Explorer
rows.description: You've always admired the beauty of urban desolation, and were ready for your next trip into town when the end of the world made your hobby much more relevant.

rows.label: Mortician
rows.description: Before the Cataclysm, you used to embalm and bury bodies. Nowadays, there is no more room in hell, so you're putting them down instead.

rows.label: Tailor
rows.description: Tailoring may not seem like the most useful skill when the world has ended.  Most people wouldn't expect a simple tailor to live long.  This is your opportunity to prove them wrong.

rows.label: Home Mechanic
rows.description: You've always loved working on cars, and have been eager to tune up something special one of these days.  At least now you'll never be wanting for materials.

rows.label: Accomplished Sleeper
rows.description: You have always been able to fall asleep easily, even when sleeping in less than ideal circumstances.

rows.label: Addiction Resistant
rows.description: Whether due to a lifetime of exposure or through simple willpower, it's harder for you to become addicted to substances, and easier to rid yourself of these addictions.

rows.label: Animal Empathy
rows.description: Peaceful animals will not run away from you, and even aggressive animals are less likely to attack.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.

rows.label: Bookworm
rows.description: There's nothing quite like the smell of a good book!  Books are more fun (or less boring) for you!

rows.label: Canine Ears
rows.description: You've grown an extra pair of canine ears.  They enhance your hearing, allowing you to hear at greater distances.

rows.label: Cannibal
rows.description: For your whole life you've been forbidden from indulging in your peculiar tastes.  Now the world's ended, and you'll be damned if anyone is going to tell you that you can't eat people.

rows.label: Carry Permit
rows.description: You prepared for trouble as best as you could, though it might not be enough for the end of the world.  In addition to any weapons your profession might start with, you start with a randomly-selected common pistol and some spare mags.  (Note: What you see in character creation does not reflect what it will select at game start.)

rows.label: Deft
rows.description: Your attacks are 10% faster overall.  You are also better at recovering from a miss, and will be able to attempt another strike faster.

rows.label: Fast Healer
rows.description: Your wounds heal themselves quicker than usual.  Sleep and medicine heal you 50% faster, and you even heal a little while awake.  Your broken limbs also heal less poorly without splints.

rows.label: Fast Learner
rows.description: You have a flexible mind, allowing you to learn skills much faster than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.

rows.label: Fast Reader
rows.description: You're a quick reader, and can get through books a lot faster than most.

rows.label: Fast Reflexes
rows.description: You have fast reflexes, allowing you to dodge attacks more easily.

rows.label: Feline Ears
rows.description: You've grown an extra pair of feline ears.  You find it easier to tune in on sounds from afar.  They are also very fluffy!

rows.label: Fleet-Footed
rows.description: You can move more quickly than most, resulting in a 15% speed bonus on sure footing.

rows.label: Fluffy Tail
rows.description: You have a long, fluffy-furred tail.  It greatly improves your balance, making your ability to dodge much higher.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

rows.label: Good Hearing
rows.description: Your hearing is better than average, and you can hear distant sounds more easily.

rows.label: Gourmand
rows.description: You eat faster, and can eat and drink more, than anyone else!  You also enjoy food more; delicious food is better for your morale, and you don't mind unsavory meals as much.

rows.label: High Adrenaline
rows.description: If you are in a very dangerous situation, you may experience a temporary rush which increases your speed and strength significantly.

rows.label: Indefatigable
rows.description: Whether due to exercise and good diet, or due to a natural propensity to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much less readily than others.  Your maximum stamina and stamina regeneration is 25% higher than usual.

rows.label: Infection Immune
rows.description: Your immune system is particularly good at resisting infections.  Your wounds will no longer become infected, altough existing infections are still dangerous.  You will also be able to install non-sterile CBMs.

rows.label: Killer Drive
rows.description: You derive enjoyment from killing things.  Putting end to life seem to spark some dark satisfaction and thrill, and you crave it every moment.

rows.label: Less Sleep
rows.description: You need less sleep than the average person.

rows.label: Light Eater
rows.description: Your metabolism is a little slower, and you require less food than most.

rows.label: Light Step
rows.description: You make no noise while walking.

rows.label: Long Tail
rows.description: You have a long, graceful tail, like that of a big cat.  It improves your balance, making your ability to dodge higher, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

rows.label: Lupine Ears
rows.description: Your hearing has evolved further and is now on par with that of wolves.  You can hear things significantly farther away.

rows.label: Martial Arts Training
rows.description: You have received some martial arts training at a local dojo.  You start with your choice of Karate, Judo, Aikido, Tai Chi, Taekwondo, Kickboxing, or Pankration.

rows.label: Masochist
rows.description: Although you still suffer the negative effects of pain, it also brings a unique pleasure to you.

rows.label: Melee Weapon Training
rows.description: You have practiced fighting with weapons.  You start with your choice of Barbaran Montante, Eskrima, Fencing, Fior Di Battaglia, Medieval Swordsmanship, Niten Ichi-Ryu, Pentjak Silat, or Sōjutsu.

rows.label: Night Vision
rows.description: You possess natural night vision, and can see further in the dark than most.

rows.label: Optimist
rows.description: Nothing gets you down!  You savor the joys of life, ignore its hardships, and are generally happier than most people.

rows.label: Outdoorsman
rows.description: You are accustomed to being exposed to the elements.  This decreases morale penalties for being wet.

rows.label: Packmule
rows.description: You can manage to find space for anything!  You can carry 40% more volume.

rows.label: Pain Recovery
rows.description: You recover from pain slightly faster than normal.

rows.label: Pain Resistant
rows.description: You have a high tolerance for pain.

rows.label: Parasite Immune
rows.description: Your body is unusually inhospitable to parasitic lifeforms.  You will never become infested with internal parasites.

rows.label: Parkour Expert
rows.description: You're skilled at clearing obstacles; terrain like railings or counters are as easy for you to move on as solid ground.  Your experience also allows you to take reduced damage from falls.

rows.label: Poison Resistant
rows.description: Your system is rather tolerant of poisons and toxins, and most will affect you less.

rows.label: Pretty
rows.description: You are a sight to behold.  People who care about such things will react more kindly to you.

rows.label: Psychopath
rows.description: You don't experience guilt like others do.  Even when you know your actions are wrong, you just don't care.

rows.label: Quick
rows.description: You're just generally quick!  You get a 10% bonus to action points.

rows.label: Rabbit Ears
rows.description: Your ears have grown into tall, flexible and pretty rabbit ears.  They're are slender and enhance your hearing beyond the normal range.

rows.label: Robust Genetics
rows.description: You have a very strong genetic base.  Mutations gained from eating mutant flesh will balance out at a higher number of positive mutations.

rows.label: Rodent Ears
rows.description: Your extra pair of ears are huge, round, and gray!  They're rather fascinating, and help you hear from a much greater distance.

rows.label: Rodent Tail
rows.description: You have a long but hairless tail.  It's a pretty effective balancing aid, but does look, uh, ratty.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

rows.label: Scout
rows.description: You're an excellent navigator and your ability to recognize distant landmarks is unmatched.  Your sight radius on the overmap extends beyond the normal range, and distant details are easier for you to resolve.

rows.label: Self-Defense Classes
rows.description: You have taken some self-defense classes at a nearby gym.  You start with your choice of Boxing, Capoeira, Krav Maga, Muay Thai, Ninjutsu, Wing Chun, or Zui Quan.

rows.label: Shaolin Adept
rows.description: You have studied the arts of the Shaolin monks.  You start with one of the five animal fighting styles: Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, or Dragon.

rows.label: Skilled Liar
rows.description: You have no qualms about bending the truth, and have practically no tells.  Telling lies and otherwise bluffing will be much easier for you.

rows.label: Spiritual
rows.description: You've always felt that there is more to the world than we can see.  Whether driven by religious beliefs or philosophical interest, you find great inspiration in studying holy texts and experiencing mystical things.

rows.label: Stimulant Psychosis
rows.description: You have a unique history with stimulants (like coffee or amphetamines).  You can tolerate a lot more of them without overdosing, but if you indulge too much, you start seeing things…

rows.label: Strong Back
rows.description: You are capable of carrying far more than someone with similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is increased by 35%.

rows.label: Strong Stomach
rows.description: You are less likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  If you throw up despite this, you won't suffer any residual nausea.

rows.label: Substance Tolerance
rows.description: You can handle intoxicants well.  Their effects clear up more quickly for you.

rows.label: Sweet Tooth
rows.description: You have a soft spot for processed foods, and gain a morale bonus from eating them.

rows.label: Terrifying
rows.description: There's something about you that creatures find frightening, and they are more likely to try to flee.

rows.label: Thick-Skinned
rows.description: Your skin is tough.  Armor is increased by 2 for your whole body.  There's a small chance you don't cut yourself on sharp terrain.

rows.label: Thick Tail
rows.description: You have a long, thick, lizardlike tail.  It helps you balance a bit but also makes a serviceable whip.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

rows.label: Tough
rows.description: It takes a lot to bring you down!  You get a 20% bonus to all hit points.

rows.label: Ursine Ears
rows.description: You've grown an extra pair of ursine ears.  You can hear things a little farther away.

rows.label: Venom Mob Protege
rows.description: You are a pupil of the Venom Clan.  You start with one of the five deadly venoms: Centipede, Viper, Scorpion, Lizard, or Toad.

rows.label: Weak Scent
rows.description: Your scent is quite weak.  Animals that track your scent will do so with more difficulty.

rows.label: Addictive Personality
rows.description: It's easier for you to become addicted to substances, and harder to rid yourself of these addictions.

rows.label: Agoraphobia
rows.description: Open spaces and wide skies make you uneasy.  Spending time outdoors drains your focus and gives you a steady morale penalty.

rows.label: Albino
rows.description: You lack skin pigmentation due to a genetic problem.  You sunburn extremely easily, and typically use an umbrella and sunglasses when going out in the sun.

rows.label: Asthmatic
rows.description: You will occasionally need to use an inhaler, or else suffer severe physical limitations.  However, you are guaranteed to start with an inhaler.

rows.label: Bad Back
rows.description: You simply cannot carry as much as people with a similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is reduced by 35%.

rows.label: Bad Knees
rows.description: Whether due to injury or age, your knees aren't particularly strong or flexible.  Moving over rough terrain will slow you down more than normal.

rows.label: Bad Temper
rows.description: Things just keep getting you down.  You tend to be unhappy, and it takes some doing to cheer you up.

rows.label: Blind
rows.description: You're totally blind, requiring you to cautiously feel out your surroundings.  Prevents crafting and construction aside from simple tasks that can be done blindfolded, and hinders many other actions as well.

rows.label: Brawler
rows.description: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, using ranged weapons is off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.

rows.label: Cattle Tail
rows.description: You have a long tail with a tuft on the end.  You find yourself instinctively swatting away flies with it, though it's not as effective at balancing you as you'd like.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.

rows.label: Chemical Imbalance
rows.description: You suffer from a minor chemical imbalance, whether mental or physical.  Minor changes to your internal chemistry will manifest themselves on occasion, such as hunger, sleepiness, narcotic effects, etc.

rows.label: Claustrophobia
rows.description: Tight, enclosed spaces make your skin crawl.  Staying indoors drains your focus and gives you a steady morale penalty.

rows.label: Clumsy
rows.description: You make more noise while walking.

rows.label: Clutter Intolerant
rows.description: Loose junk everywhere grates on your nerves.  Piles of items scattered on the ground nearby will steadily erode your morale.

rows.label: Deaf
rows.description: You're not able to hear anything, and as such you're not able to talk to NPCs.

rows.label: Disorganized
rows.description: You are terrible at organizing and storing your possessions.  You can carry 40% less volume.

rows.label: Far-Sighted
rows.description: Without reading glasses, you are unable to read anything, and take penalties on melee accuracy and electronics/tailoring crafting.  However, you are guaranteed to start with a pair of reading glasses.

rows.label: Fashion Deficient
rows.description: You have no sense of style, and don't care about wearing anything 'fancy';  you'd be perfectly happy to wear non-matching socks, or wear socks and sandals.  You get no morale bonus from fancy equipment.

rows.label: Fast Metabolism
rows.description: You require more food than most people.  On a plus side, you are more resistant to cold.

rows.label: Flimsy
rows.description: Your body can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 25% lower than usual, and you heal slightly slower.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

rows.label: Fragile
rows.description: Your body is extremely fragile.  Its maximum HP is 75% lower than usual, and you heal much slower.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

rows.label: Frail
rows.description: Your body breaks very easily.  Its maximum HP is 50% lower than usual, and you heal slower.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.

rows.label: Genetic Downward Spiral
rows.description: The events of the Cataclysm have damaged your DNA beyond repair.  You mutate frequently, and all mutations you receive (from any source) are negative.

rows.label: Glass Jaw
rows.description: Your head can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 20% lower than usual.

rows.label: Grain Intolerance
rows.description: You have a rare allergy that prevents you from eating most types of grains such as wheat or oats.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

rows.label: Gun Nut
rows.description: REAL survivors use guns!  You refuse to use crude bows, crossbows, or other primitive ranged weapons even if your life depends on it.

rows.label: Gun Shy
rows.description: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, using firearms is completely off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.  Other ranged weapons, however, are totally fine.

rows.label: Hates Fruit
rows.description: You despise eating fruits.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

rows.label: Hates Vegetables
rows.description: You have problems with eating vegetables.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

rows.label: High Thirst
rows.description: Your body dries out easily; you need to drink more water.

rows.label: Hoarder
rows.description: You don't feel right unless you're carrying as much as you can.  You suffer morale penalties for carrying less than maximum volume (weight is ignored).  Xanax can help control this anxiety.

rows.label: Illiterate
rows.description: You never learned to read!  Books and computers are off-limits to you.

rows.label: Imperceptive Healer
rows.description: Wounds are incredibly dangerous to you, as they barely heal at all.  Your HP heals at 10% of the regular rate.

rows.label: Inattentive
rows.description: You never paid attention to your surroundings and specifically to people around you.  You can't judge intent of critters you see.

rows.label: Insomniac
rows.description: You have a hard time falling asleep, even under the best circumstances!

rows.label: Jittery
rows.description: When hungry or under the effects of stimulants, you may find your hands shaking uncontrollably, severely reducing your Dexterity.

rows.label: Junkfood Intolerance
rows.description: Something in those heavily processed foods doesn't agree with you.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

rows.label: Lactose Intolerance
rows.description: You, like 75 percent of the world, cannot tolerate milk or milk based products.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.

rows.label: Languorous
rows.description: Whether due to lack of exercise and poor diet, or due to a natural disinclination to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much more readily than others.  Your maximum stamina and stamina regeneration is 25% lower than usual.

rows.label: Meat Intolerance
rows.description: You have problems with eating meat.  It's possible for you to eat it, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from it.

rows.label: Mood Swings
rows.description: Your morale will shift up and down at random, often dramatically.

rows.label: Narcoleptic
rows.description: You randomly fall asleep without any reason.

rows.label: Near-Sighted
rows.description: Without glasses, your seeing radius is severely reduced!  However, you are guaranteed to start with a pair of glasses.

rows.label: Nomad
rows.description: You're too adventurous for your own good.  The more time you spend somewhere, the unhappier it makes you to be there.

rows.label: Nyctophobia
rows.description: You are terribly afraid of the dark.  You refuse to enter very dark areas.  If you somehow still happen to stay in dark areas, you suffer from various detrimental mental and physical effects.

rows.label: Pacifist
rows.description: You don't like thinking about violence.  Your combat skills advance much slower than usual, and you feel more guilt about killing.

rows.label: Pain Sensitive
rows.description: For some reason, things always seem to hurt you more.  Pain dealt to you is increased by 25%.

rows.label: Poor Healer
rows.description: Your health recovery is severely impaired.  Your HP heals at 33% of the regular rate.

rows.label: Poor Hearing
rows.description: Your hearing is poor, and you may not hear quiet or far-off noises.

rows.label: Psychosis
rows.description: You will periodically suffer from delusions, ranging from minor effects to full visual hallucinations.  Some of these effects may be controlled through the use of Thorazine.

rows.label: Pyromaniac
rows.description: You have an unhealthy obsession with fire, and you get anxious if you don't light them every now and then or stand near them often.  However, you gain a mood bonus from doing so.

rows.label: Savant
rows.description: You tend to specialize in one skill and be poor at all others.  You advance at half speed in all skills except your best one.  Note that combining this with Fast Learner will come out to a slower rate of learning for all skills.

rows.label: Sleepy
rows.description: You need sleep more often, but still spend most of your time awake.

rows.label: Slow Footed
rows.description: You can't move as fast as most, resulting in a 15% speed penalty on flat ground.

rows.label: Slow Healer
rows.description: Your wounds heal a little slower than most.  Your HP heals at 75% of the regular rate.

rows.label: Slow Learner
rows.description: You are slow to grasp new ideas, and thus learn things more slowly than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.

rows.label: Slow Reader
rows.description: You're a slow reader, and it takes you longer to get through books than most.

rows.label: Strong Scent
rows.description: Your scent is particularly strong.  It's not offensive to humans, but animals that track your scent will do so more easily.

rows.label: Tail Fin
rows.description: You have a fin-like tail.  It allows you to swim more quickly, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.  Slightly increases wet benefits.

rows.label: Thin-Skinned
rows.description: Your skin is fragile.  Physical armor is reduced by 2 across your whole body.

rows.label: Topographagnosia
rows.description: Focal brain damage has rendered you incapable of recognizing landmarks and orienting yourself in your surroundings, severely crippling your sight radius on the overmap.

rows.label: Ugly
rows.description: You're not much to look at.  People who care about such things will react poorly to you.

rows.label: Wayfarer
rows.description: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, traveling with vehicles is off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.

rows.label: Wool Allergy
rows.description: You are badly allergic to wool, and cannot wear any clothing made of the substance.

rows.label: Facial hair: anchor beard
rows.description: You have a moustache and a beard starting with a strip going down from the bottom lip, then tracing the jaw lines.  It looks a bit like an anchor, thus the name.

rows.label: Facial hair: beard

rows.label: Facial hair: jaw scruff

rows.label: Facial hair: mutton chops beard

rows.label: Facial hair: shenandoah

rows.label: Facial hair: short boxed beard

rows.label: Facial hair: sideburns

valid.name: character creation on the bionics page

rows.label: Alarm System
rows.description: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.

rows.label: Anti-Glare Compensators
rows.description: Your eyes have quick-reacting transition lenses surgically installed over them.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect you from bright flashes, and protect your eyes when welding.

rows.label: Battery System
rows.description: You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use 'E' to drain charge from a battery.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

rows.label: Bionic Infolink
rows.description: A state of the art communications and information package has been installed in your body.  While the cell phone network may be down, it can still double as a two-way radio.  Additionally tells you the time and local air temperature, provides a silent alarm clock function, and if activated will give a more detailed readout on local weather conditions.

rows.label: Blood Analysis
rows.description: Small sensors have been surgically implanted in your heart, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

rows.label: Cable Charger System
rows.description: You have a complex port surgically mounted above your hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via cable.

rows.label: Cranial Flashlight
rows.description: Surgically mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.

rows.label: Electromagnetic Unit
rows.description: Surgically embedded in your right hand is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to use your own strength to pull all nearby magnetic objects towards you.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.

rows.label: Enhanced Hearing
rows.description: When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing, and preexisting hearing problems will be fixed.

rows.label: Ethanol Burner
rows.description: You burn alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.

rows.label: Finger Lighter
rows.description: The index fingers of both hands have powerful fire starters which extend from the tip.

rows.label: Fingertip Razors
rows.description: You possess razor-sharp claws underneath your fingernails that do a fair amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever your fingertips are uncovered, and which you can use with some precision to cut and butcher..

rows.label: Gasoline Fuel Cell CBM
rows.description: A small gasoline fuel cell fixed to your scapula.  Despite its limited energy output compared to other fuel cells, this device still produces a significant amount of heat dissipated through a heat exhaust protruding from your back.  A diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders has been meshed with your circulatory system and serves as a fuel tank.

rows.label: Integrated Toolset
rows.description: Surgically implanted in your hands and fingers is a set of tools - screwdriver, hammer, wrench, hacksaw, drill, welder, and heating elements.  You can use this in place of many tools when crafting.

rows.label: Intravenous Needletip
rows.description: The flesh of the inside of your middle finger has been replaced with a tube leading into your arteries, with a retractable needle extending out of the tip of the finger when clenched.  This lets you pump intravenous drugs like morphine directly into your bloodstream without needing to carry a syringe.

rows.label: Joint Torsion Ratchet
rows.description: Your joints have been surgically equipped with torsion ratchets that slowly generate power when you move.  Whilst this is toggled, moving will require more effort, though more power will be generated.

rows.label: LED Tattoo
rows.description: A small LED display just beneath your dermal layer can be illuminated on command to show patterns of your choice at dim or bright luminosity.  It doesn't provide enough light, but it can suffice for reading or crafting if you have nothing else.

rows.label: Linguistic Coprocessor
rows.description: The left hemisphere of your brain has been augmented with a microcomputer that moderately increases the speed that language and written words are processed, granting a 25% increase to reading speed.

rows.label: Metabolic Interchange
rows.description: Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected; bionic energy is replenished by burning calories.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

rows.label: Power Storage
rows.description: A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 100 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.

rows.label: Power Storage Mk. II
rows.description: A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 250 kJ.

rows.label: Solar Panels
rows.description: Installed on your back is a set of retractable, reinforced solar panels resembling angular butterfly wings.  When in direct sunlight, they will automatically deploy and slowly recharge your power level.

rows.label: Taste Modifier
rows.description: A set of highly sensitive sensors is installed in your mouth.  The active bionic will nullify the taste of all comestibles with negative enjoyment value at the cost of draining bionic power.

rows.label: Acidic Discharge
rows.description: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges acid into your muscles, causing sharp pain and minor damage.

rows.label: Bionic-Induced Deformity
rows.description: A combination of poor surgical installation and unpleasant scarring has lead to the malfunctioning bionic catastrophe you call your face.  People who mind that you look like a dime-store Frankenstein will react poorly to your appearance.

rows.label: Bionic Nostril
rows.description: You're really not sure how the CBM ended up in your nose, but no matter how it got there this badly misplaced bionic makes it difficult to breathe.  Increases mouth encumbrance by ten.

rows.label: Bionic Short Circuit
rows.description: A poorly-wired bionic which fails to serve its intended purpose, this malfunctioning device periodically short-circuits, causing systemic muscle tremors.

rows.label: Bionic Visual Impairment
rows.description: Due to a badly misplaced dielectric stylette, you are now suffering from mild optic neuropathy.  Increases eye encumbrance by ten.

rows.label: Electrical Discharge
rows.description: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges electricity through your body, causing pain and brief paralysis but no damage.

rows.label: Electrical Drain
rows.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  It doesn't perform any useful function, but will occasionally draw power from your batteries.

rows.label: Endocrine Enervator
rows.description: Through a combination of psychochemical manipulation and old fashioned electrical nerve stimulation, this malfunctioning bionic alters your brain chemistry in such a way as to cause fatigue.  You will find yourself tiring a bit faster than before.

rows.label: Glowy Thing
rows.description: You don't think that capacitor is *meant* to glow, but it does, and usually at bad times.  A malfunctioning bionic randomly turns on and off, causing you to glow and making you visible in the dark without improving how much you can see in the slightest.

rows.label: Itchy Metal Thing
rows.description: A bionic of some sort, so badly installed that you cannot even tell what it was originally supposed to be.  Sometimes it itches horribly.

rows.label: Leaky Bionic
rows.description: This botched piece of bionic hardware slowly leaks electrolytic compounds, piezoelectric nanomaterials, and other high-tech contaminants into your bloodstream.  Needless to say, this is not good for your health.

rows.label: Motor Control Overstimulator
rows.description: One piezoelectric solenoid surgically installed backwards, two crossed wires, and four burned-out capacitors later you started falling on your face and writhing around at the least convenient times.  This incorrectly-configured bionic periodically stuns you for a short duration.

rows.label: Noisemaker
rows.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  It will occasionally emit a loud burst of noise.

rows.label: Power Overload
rows.description: Damaged power circuits cause short-circuiting inside your muscles when your batteries are above 75% capacity, causing greatly reduced strength.  This has no effect if you have no internal batteries.

rows.label: Self-Locking Thumbs
rows.description: Self-locking thumbs hold tight (even when you really don't want them to) and don't let go (even when you'd rather they did).  Increases hand encumbrance by ten, while failing to improve your ability to hold objects whatsoever.

rows.label: Sleep Mode Shutdown
rows.description: For better or worse, this CBM suppresses most stimuli while asleep, preventing you from waking up from those causes.

rows.label: Squeaky Ankles
rows.description: In a cruel twist of fate, a poorly executed CBM surgery has given you a pair of useless bionics which make squeaking noises when you walk.

rows.label: Taste Fouler
rows.description: A malfunctioning processor haphazardly interfaced with your taste receptors has given everything you consume a horrid bitter taste.  Food and drink will severely harm your morale.

rows.label: Visual Disruptor
rows.description: A malfunctioning bionic which causes occasional visual distortion and pixelation.

rows.label: Voice Remodulator
rows.description: You will likely spend the rest of your days serving as a walking testament to why you don't opt for the Autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package'.  A remodulator unit jammed down your throat has given you a creepy robot voice.

rows.label: Wire-Induced Stiffness
rows.description: Improperly installed wires cause a physical stiffness in most of your body, causing increased encumbrance.

valid.name: character creation on the skills page

stats.label: Upgrading Bashing Weapons by 2 levels costs 1 point

rows.label: Bashing Weapons
rows.description: Your skill in fighting with blunt weaponry, from rocks and sticks to baseball bats and the butts of rifles.  Skill increases damage, and higher levels will improve the accuracy of an attack.

rows.label: Cutting Weapons
rows.description: Your skill in fighting with weaponry designed to cut, hack and slash an opponent.  Lower levels of skill increase accuracy and damage, while higher levels will help to bypass heavy armor and thick hides.

rows.label: Dodging
rows.description: Your ability to dodge an oncoming threat, be it an enemy's attack, a triggered trap, or a falling rock.  This skill is also used in attempts to fall gracefully, and for other acrobatic feats.  The first number shown includes modifiers, and the second does not.

rows.label: Melee
rows.description: Your skill and finesse in personal combat, both with and without a weapon.  Higher levels can significantly increase the accuracy and effectiveness of your physical attacks.

rows.label: Piercing Weapons
rows.description: Your skill in fighting with knives, spears and other such stabbing implements.  Skill increases attack accuracy as well as the chance of inflicting a deadly and critical blow.

rows.label: Unarmed Combat
rows.description: Your skill in hand-to-hand fighting, with unarmed weapons or empty-handed.  Skill increases attack accuracy and unlocks techniques in many martial arts, while also providing a bonus to bare-handed damage.

rows.label: Archery
rows.description: Your skill in using bow weapons, from hand-carved self bows to complex compound bows.  Quiet and effective, they require strength of body and sight to wield, and are not terribly accurate over a long distance.

rows.label: Handguns
rows.description: Handguns have poor accuracy compared to rifles, but are usually quick to fire and reload faster than other guns.  They are very effective at close quarters, though unsuited for long range engagement.

rows.label: Launchers
rows.description: Your skill in using heavy weapons like rocket, grenade or missile launchers.  These weapons have a variety of applications and may carry immense destructive power, but they are cumbersome and hard to manage.

rows.label: Marksmanship
rows.description: Your overall skill in using bows and firearms.  With higher levels, this general experience increases accuracy with any bows or firearms, but is secondary to practice with the type of ranged weapon in question.

rows.label: Rifles
rows.description: Rifles have terrific range and accuracy compared to other firearms, but may be slow to fire and reload, and can prove difficult to use in close quarters.  Fully automatic rifles can fire rapidly, but are harder to handle properly.

rows.label: Shotguns
rows.description: Shotguns are easy to shoot and can inflict massive damage, but their effectiveness and accuracy decline rapidly with range.  Slugs can be loaded into shotguns to provide greater range, though they are somewhat inaccurate.

rows.label: Submachine Guns
rows.description: Comprised of an automatic rifle carbine designed to fire a pistol cartridge, submachine guns can reload and fire quickly, sometimes in bursts, but they are relatively inaccurate and may be prone to mechanical failures.

rows.label: Throwing
rows.description: Your skill in throwing objects over a distance.  Skill increases accuracy, and at higher levels, the range of a throw.

rows.label: Cooking
rows.description: Your skill in combining food ingredients to make other, tastier food items.  It may also be used in certain chemical mixtures and other, more esoteric tasks.

rows.label: Electronics
rows.description: Your skill in dealing with electrical systems, used in the craft and repair of objects with electrical components.  This skill is an important part of installing and managing bionic implants.

rows.label: Fabrication
rows.description: Your skill in working with raw materials and shaping them into useful objects.  This skill plays an important role in the crafting of many objects.

rows.label: Survival
rows.description: Your skill in surviving the wilderness, and in crafting various basic survival items.  This also covers your ability to skin and butcher animals for meat and hides.

rows.label: Tailoring
rows.description: Your skill in the craft and repair of clothing, bags, blankets and other textiles.  Affects knitting, sewing, stitching, weaving, and nearly anything else involving a needle and thread.

rows.label: Athletics
rows.description: Your capability to perform physically demanding tasks such as running, jumping, climbing, and swimming efficiently. This skill influences your overall performance when swimming, reduces stamina consumption of physical activity, and reduces the impact of encumbrance.

rows.label: Computers
rows.description: Your skill in accessing and manipulating computers.  Higher levels can allow a user to navigate complex software systems and even bypass their security.

rows.label: Driving
rows.description: Your skill in operating and steering a vehicle in motion.  A higher level allows greater control over vehicles at higher speeds, and reduces the penalty of shooting while driving.

rows.label: First Aid
rows.description: Your skill in effecting emergency medical treatment.  Higher levels allow better use of medicines and items like bandages and first aid kits, and reduce the failure and complication rates of medical procedures.

rows.label: Mechanics
rows.description: Your skill in engineering, maintaining and repairing vehicles and other mechanical systems.  This skill covers the craft of items with complex parts, and plays a role in the installation of bionic equipment.

rows.label: Trapping
rows.description: Your skill in creating, setting, finding and disarming traps safely and effectively.  This skill does not affect the evasion of traps that are triggered.

rows.label: Bartering
rows.description: Your skill in bargaining, haggling, and trading with others.  Higher levels increase the odds of getting the better end of a deal, and might even see you convincing others to give you free stuff.

rows.label: Speaking
rows.description: Your skill in speaking to other people.  Covers ability in boasting, flattery, threats, persuasion, lies, and other facets of interpersonal communication.  Works best in conjunction with a high level of intelligence.
